name: Pashhur
background: A serving priest who was inside the Sanctuary when the Temple veil tore from top to bottom at 3:00 PM.

genericReactions.physical: This thread... it's from the Veil! How did you get this?
genericReactions.testimonial: I was on duty. I saw it tear. From the top down. No man did this.
genericReactions.digital: The records will say there was an earthquake. It was more than that.
genericReactions.environmental: The Holy of Holies... exposed. It was a terrifying sight.
genericReactions.analytical: You can't measure the presence of God leaving a place. But you can feel it.
genericReactions.prophecy: The prophets spoke of the Lord suddenly coming to His temple. I think... I think He has.
